name: kinetic word run states the film's core claim
looks: A short sentence builds across a rapid run of hard cuts, one to three words per cut, each slamming onto a plain dark field in heavy white type with a soft radial glow pulsing behind it on every beat.
build: One clip per word-group, cut exactly on the beat; a radial gradient behind the text pulses opacity on each cut to sell the impact, with a slight scale pop-in (1.05 to 1, power3.out, about 150ms) per group.
sound: A hit on every cut, slightly louder on the sentence's final word.
prompt: State the film's one core claim as a fast run of hard-cut word groups, heavy sans type on a plain dark field, each cut landing with a soft radial pulse of light behind it so the sentence feels struck into place rather than read.
